decisions.reason: The button pull-up change does not alter the touch interfaces; the source message's separate touch clause is already represented by its own same-message MODIFY.
The button pull-up change does not alter the PIR interface; the source message's separate PIR clause is already represented by its own same-message MODIFY.
The R16/R17/R18 pull-up decision concerns the GPIO buttons and switch, not the separate J_RESET input connected to EN.
Changing panel-control input biasing on the main board does not change the sensor-board connector matrix.
The backlight's supply jumper and GPIO42 switching circuit are independent of the R16/R17/R18 panel-input pull-ups.
The panel-button bias correction does not change the integrated board's light-sensor or omitted JST connector requirements.
The SPS30 SEL-to-GND I2C-mode selection is unrelated to the panel GPIO input pull-up configuration.
The source decision changes discrete panel-input biasing and does not alter sensor logic-voltage compatibility or level-shifter policy.
The addressable LED power and data interface is electrically independent of the R16/R17/R18 panel-control inputs.
The panel-input pull-up change does not affect the LED array board's count, selected part, or physical implementation.
The passive buzzer selection and interface remain unchanged by the panel GPIO button and switch bias correction.
Using 3V3 for the panel-input pull-ups does not modify the interboard power connectors, topology, or pinout rules.
